description: Ingest your prop catalog: footprint, height, pivot and category computed from each GLB. Returns a catalogId for place. Price: $0.50 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Level design: Level dressing for 3D games.

bounds.description: Meters, model space, Y up. Used only when no mesh is given.

glb.description: Base64 GLB. Footprint, height and pivot are computed from the mesh.

glbUrl.description: URL of a GLB, used when glb is not given.

id.description: Your prefab / asset name. Placements refer to it.

name: level_design_catalog
